title: APS RPAC Meeting 7/22/2026 - Cholla conversion, 2026 IRP Base Case, Summer Preparedness, IRP filing extension
summary: Covers planned gas conversion of two Cholla units (380 MW), APS's move from AURORA to PLEXOS for the 2026 IRP with a zonal topology that co-optimizes transmission expansion (discrete build-or-not projects from APS transmission planning) with generation and enforces deliverability. Reference case: Four Corners exit 2031, new gas pipeline flowing by 2030, technology-neutral candidates. Early PLEXOS result: $38.8B modeled portfolio plus $1.7B transmission investment (8 new transmission projects). Summer 2026: 8,648 MW forecast peak, 1,326 MW reserve margin; 2026 additions: 775 MW storage, 433 MW solar+storage, 318 MW solar, 500 MW wind, 90 MW gas CT. ACC extended the 2026 IRP filing deadline to Oct 30, 2026.

findings.statement: APS plans to convert two Cholla units (Joseph City, AZ) from coal to natural gas, adding 380 MW dispatchable capacity; last coal burn March 2025; conversion is being compared against 2025 ASRFP bids.

Early PLEXOS capacity-expansion solution selected 8 new transmission projects ($1.7B transmission investment) with a $38.8B modeled portfolio cost; transmission additions indicate material deliverability needs.

2026 IRP co-optimizes transmission and generation: transmission upgrades are discrete build-or-not projects from APS transmission planning, with hourly simultaneous flow limits and a requirement that each line deliver capacity during reliability hours; zonal topology includes Northern Arizona, Four Corners, Western Arizona, Maricopa County, Southeast Arizona, New Mexico and the energy market.

Reference case assumptions: Four Corners exit 2031; new gas pipeline with gas flowing by 2030; technology-agnostic candidates (BESS 6-8 hr, CC, CT, nuclear, geothermal, pumped hydro, solar, wind, Cholla conversion, etc.); no voluntary clean energy targets; PRM/accreditation from the 2025 APS RA study (perfect capacity); E3 market prices.
2026 forecast peak 8,648 MW with 1,326 MW reserve margin; summer-to-date peak 8,629 MW, with 9 days above 8,000 MW.

Summer 2026 resource additions: 775 MW energy storage (Agave 150, Beehive 250, Desert Bloom 150, Justice 150, Pluto 75); 433 MW solar+storage (Catclaw 250, Maricopa Energy Center 183); 318 MW solar (Ironwood 168, Papago Solar 150); 500 MW wind (West Camp); 90 MW gas (Sundance CT expansion).

On July 8, 2026 the ACC extended the 2026 IRP filing deadline to Oct 30, 2026; stakeholder comments due Feb 10, 2027; Staff assessment/proposed order Sep 13, 2027. Saguaro CEC filing planned July 24, 2026.
APS system: 1.4 million customers, 5,939 miles of transmission lines, 477 substations, 34,646 sq-mi territory.

open_questions: Which 8 transmission projects did PLEXOS select and at what kV?
Where is the new gas pipeline (Transwestern expansion) delivered and its capacity?
